about_the_game:
Further Expand Kaz's Latest Adventure!

This is Optional Paid Downloadable Content for Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls.

[It is optional but recomended you finish the base games story before playing Kaz's Adventure 2: Frozen Kingdom]

Explore the Frozen Kingdom

“When the last flame meets the frozen crown, a soul shall rise with the sun.” - Rowan

Set 1 year after the base games story, Kaz enters the Frozen Kingdom only to find returning enemys from his past and the chilling Ice King who he must fight to learn more about an ancient power he might have that will allow him to defy death itself and return to the mortal realm.

Along the way, Rowan will help guide Kaz throughout the Frozen Kingdom to reach the Ice King and learn more about the prophecy that caused the downfall of his species all those years ago.

Utilise the Grapling Hook

Utilise Kaz's new tool he picked up on his way to the Frozen Kingdom, the Grappling Hook, this tool allows Kaz to traverse levels BOTH horizontal and vertically in a new twist to the formula that allows for new challenges and possabilities.

content_descriptors.notes: This game deals with grief and truama related themes.
